Name: Jeshimon
ModernLocation: Wilderness region near Zahrat al Kula
Description: The desert waste that the wilderness journeys and David's wanderings both look toward: Pisgah's height faces it, Balak brought Balaam to a height overlooking it, and the hill of Hachilah stood on its southern edge.
BiblicalSignificance: Jeshimon is Scripture's word for the empty land itself, the backdrop against which the wilderness years and David's fugitive years both unfold.
KeyScriptures: Numbers 21:20; Numbers 23:28; 1 Samuel 23:19; 1 Samuel 23:24; 1 Samuel 26:1; 1 Samuel 26:3
